identity.real_world_identity_notes: Opened secondary sources conflict between five-speed manual and six-speed sequential descriptions. Exact AMS2 testing resolves the modeled car to a six-speed sequential stick without paddles without claiming that every historical chassis matched it.

wheel_rim.notes: Direct cockpit inspection showed a round rim without an integrated display; exact diameter remains unknown.

notes: With Auto Clutch disabled, the car stalled when moving from rest without physical clutch input.
All six sequential-stick gears accepted clutch-free full-throttle upshifts with automatic throttle cut.
Clutch-free downshifts were accepted and no automatic throttle blip was observed; authentic rev matching therefore requires the driver to blip the throttle manually.
The six modeled gears resolve the conflicting opened sources only for this exact AMS2 representation.
Live-tested in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with Auto Clutch disabled.
Six modeled gears, standing-start clutch, sequential stick without paddles, automatic cut, no automatic blip, and round no-display rim were directly observed.

confidence.basis: Exact simulator identity, modeled hardware, and shift behavior were directly tested. Conflicting historical sources remain explicit and are not generalized beyond the modeled car.

claims.basis: Official release context and exact live CarModel/class observation establish the simulated identity.
The record preserves the historical source conflict while direct testing resolves the exact modeled car to six-speed sequential-stick operation.
Direct current-game tests and cockpit inspection establish the start clutch, automatic cut, absence of automatic blip, required manual rev matching, and wheel shape.
